items.item: A breadcrumb leads back to the contracts list and ends with the contract number, and the header shows the contract number, vendor name, a status badge with text, and at most four key fields (such as value, start and end date)
items.evidence: Breadcrumb `Procurement / Hợp đồng / HĐ-2026-0187` (nav aria-label="Breadcrumb", link 'Hợp đồng' to list, ending span 'HĐ-2026-0187'). Header h1 'HĐ-2026-0187', status badge 'Đang hiệu lực' (bg-emerald-50), vendor name in subtitle and dl. Exactly 4 key fields in `<dl class="mt-5 grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4">`: Nhà cung cấp, Giá trị hợp đồng (VND), Thời hạn, Người phụ trách.

items.item: The header has one primary action (such as "Renew contract") and puts other actions such as edit or terminate in a secondary or overflow position
items.evidence: The single prominent primary-styled button is 'Chỉnh sửa hợp đồng' (Edit contract, bg-blue-700), while 'Gia hạn hợp đồng' (Renew), 'Tạo bản sao', 'Tải PDF' and 'Chấm dứt hợp đồng' (Terminate) are all placed inside the `#overflowMenu` kebab menu. This inverts the expected pattern — edit itself is the primary action instead of being secondary/overflow, and renew (the suggested primary example) is buried in the overflow menu.

items.item: Vendor contacts show each person's name and role, with email as a `mailto:` link and phone as a `tel:` link, and the primary contact is marked with text
items.evidence: Contact 'Nguyễn Văn Hùng' has role text 'Quản lý tài khoản (Account manager)', `<a href="mailto:hung.nguyen@minhphat.vn">`, `<a href="tel:+84903111222">`, and a text badge 'Chính' (Primary) next to the name. Other two contacts also show mailto/tel links and role text.

items.item: Payment milestones show the due date, amount and status, with amounts right-aligned in tabular figures and formatted as currency, and the milestones are ordered with overdue and due-soon ones first
items.evidence: Table columns 'Ngày đến hạn', 'Số tiền (VND)', 'Trạng thái'; amount cells use `class="px-3 py-2.5 text-right tabular-nums"` e.g. '490.000.000'. Row order in tbody: Mốc 3 (Sắp đến hạn, 30/11/2026) first, then Mốc 4 (not due), then the two already-paid milestones — due-soon item placed first as required.

items.item: Overdue or upcoming milestones are marked with a text label (such as "Overdue" or "Due in 5 days"), not by colour alone
items.evidence: Status cell for Mốc 3 reads text 'Sắp đến hạn' (Due soon) inside the amber badge `Sắp đến hạn`, distinct from the other text labels 'Chưa đến hạn' and 'Đã thanh toán' — label text differs per state, not colour-only.

items.item: The renewal or expiry date is shown as an absolute date with the remaining time stated in words (such as "Expires in 45 days")
items.evidence: Renewal tab shows only the absolute date 'Ngày gia hạn tiếp theo: 28/02/2027' and a note about when the notice window opens ('Thời gian gửi thông báo gia hạn bắt đầu từ 01/12/2026'); no relative wording like 'Hết hạn sau 115 ngày' / 'Expires in N days' appears anywhere on the page.

items.item: Amendments are listed with number, date, a short summary and who approved them, using absolute dates
items.evidence: Each `<li>` in #panel-amendments shows 'Phụ lục số 3/2/1', a summary paragraph (e.g. 'Gia hạn tiến độ giao hàng giai đoạn 2 thêm 30 ngày...'), and 'Phê duyệt bởi Lê Thu Hà · <time datetime="2026-09-28">28/09/2026</time>' with absolute `<time>` dates.

items.item: Each section has an empty state with a next action (such as "Add contact" or "Add amendment"), a loading state, and an inline error with retry
items.evidence: No empty-state, loading/skeleton, or error/retry markup exists anywhere in the HTML or script (grep for 'empty|loading|error|retry|skeleton' returns no matches); sections render only their populated list/table markup.

items.item: Terminating the contract asks for confirmation that names the contract and the consequence, with a verb button label and focus not on the destructive button
items.evidence: The 'Chấm dứt hợp đồng' overflow menu item (`<button class="...text-red-700...">Chấm dứt hợp đồng</button>`) has no click handler in the `<script>` block and there is no confirmation dialog/modal element in the DOM at all — clicking it does nothing observable.

notes: Visually restrained Tailwind admin page with flat white cards, no gradients/glass/emoji, small border-radius (4-6px per tailwind.config), and semantic (not decorative) status-color badges — no obvious template tells spotted. Main gaps are process/interaction depth: the header's primary/secondary action hierarchy is inverted (edit is primary, renew/terminate are overflow), no empty/loading/error states exist for any tab, no relative 'expires in N days' phrasing is shown, and the terminate action has no confirmation flow wired up at all.
